title: Does anyone know what this creature might be?
content: Someone advised I post my story here. This is a dream I had last night and it really stuck to me. Something about it doesn't feel right at all. I literally just woke up, it's 7am where Im at as im writing this. I had a very weird nightmare and when I was inside it it felt nostalgic almost like it had either actually happened to me already or like I had already dreamed of this in the past, either way, I don't remember either of them happening. Something about this nightmare is super unsettling to me and not because it was creepy but because it feels almost like I needed to go through it for something (not sure eif that makes sense). The nightmare: Myself, parents, and little brother were driving for 3 hours to a store to buy art supplies. When we got there, the place was eerily quiet. After entering the building my dad disappeared but it was almost like no one cared and like it was normal. We kept walking, when a worker greeted us. She started walking with us and showing all the different supplies. At some point I said something that seemed to trigger everything going south. I new I needed to grab something for my little brother who was standing on place like he couldn't see anything and needed help. My mom was walking around like nothing was wrong, and a black shadowy figure with huge circular eyes started talking to me and chasing me and making me do things to stay alive. At some point it possessed my mom or took her shape and started using that as a manipulation tactic. I would constantly go up and down flights of stairs. The number 4 seemed to be a big trend in the dream. At the end I woke up after hugging my little brother and telling him it'll be ok. Needless to say I am pretty shaken from it. But I am wondering if anyone has ever heard of a creature such at that? Edit: I just went back to sleep after writing that and I woke up right now because of my alarm. I had a continuation of that. I was talking with a friend, I was wanting to see if I was crazy. We went to a teacher's class to discuss it but he had taken interest in it (we were for some reason back in my old high school). While we were talking I realized the teacher had been taken over too so I came up with an excuse to leave. "Omg I'm so sorry Mr. XXXX, but I forgot the two of us had a meeting with another teacher we had to go to" and grabbed her arm and left. While I said that I saw those same huge empty eyes and I could feel them staring at me as we walked away. We then got to a huge room, we was trying to talk about it while we walked but I told her to shut the fuck up and stop saying all of it out loud or he will hear us. When we got to the room, everyone in there had the same eyes except for that friend. And then the alarm went off so I woke up. Edit 2: I couldn't find a picture close enough to the thing I saw so I decided to try drawing it. I am not an artist but this is somewhat of what I saw https://i.redgifs.com/i/peacefuladolescentcanvasback.jpg (Using redgifs cuz I can't add a picture here so just did this..)
